description_en: Executes a specified operation on a migration task
description_zh: 指定的迁移任务执行指定的操作
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq execute-migration-operation --migration-id 44 --instance-id rmq-cn-x0r37kel000 --stage-type MIGRATE_MESSAGE --operation-id 2729 --operation-param paramData=Migrate_forward:_action_:_MIGRATE_FORWARD_,_targetStage_:_MIGRATE_FINISH_Migrate_backward:_action_:_MIGRATE_BACKWARD_,_targetStage_:_MIGRATE_WAIT --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteMigrationOperation

fields.help_en:
The parameters for the operation, provided as a JSON string. See the example for details.

The action (operation) field accepts the following values:

- MIGRATE\_FORWARD (fast-forward migration)

- MIGRATE\_BACKWARD (backward migration)

The targetStage field accepts the following values:

- MIGRATE\_WAIT (Read from and write to the source cluster)

- DOUBLE\_READ (Write to the source cluster and perform redundant reads)

- SWITCH\_WRITE (Write to the destination cluster and perform redundant reads)

- MIGRATE\_FINISH (Read from and write to the destination cluster)

> * For a fast-forward migration, you can only advance one stage at a time.
>
> * For a backward migration, you can roll back to any previous stage
fields.help_zh:
参数信息，参数类型为json字符串，参考示例。

action（操作）字段枚举值如下：
- MIGRATE_FORWARD(迁移前进)
- MIGRATE_BACKWARD(迁移回退)

targetStage（目标阶段）字段枚举值如下：
  - MIGRATE_WAIT(读写源集群)
  - DOUBLE_READ(写源集群冗余读)
  - SWITCH_WRITE(写目标集群冗余读)
  - MIGRATE_FINISH(读写目标集群)


> 
> - 关于迁移前进，只能按照顺序逐个阶段向前推进。
> - 关于迁移回滚，可以回滚至之前的任何一个阶段
